name: 36298-decode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), sm90. Driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one GPU, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 15% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 32 tokens (min = max) and output exactly 128 (min = max); temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, ignore_eos true so all 128 tokens are always generated. Prefix caching off. Static seed 36298. The Llama-3 chat template adds 10 tokens, so the engine sees a 42-token prompt, not 32.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant generating 128-token replies to brief prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: source checkout 2ad7c0335f3a (`git describe --tags` = v0.18.2rc0-84-g2ad7c0335f3a),
# named by `env.yaml: venv`. Nothing here is tuned.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

# Declared, not a default: the engine would otherwise auto-select a hand-written backend here.
attention-config: {"backend": "FLEX_ATTENTION"}

enable-prefix-caching: false
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192

# Pinned equal to max-model-len. The engine's own default for this key depends on the device and
# on how the engine is entered, so leaving it implicit is not reproducible across machines.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
